subject: Invoice delivery & archive retention — portal push with AP email copy
messages:
From: Elena Popov <elena.popov@veloworks.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: ap@veloworks.com
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery & archive retention — initial questions

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Quick question on how Redwood will send invoices once we go live. Our AP team would like a daily delivery of invoices into our accounts portal (SFTP or API feed), but they also require an email copy to ap@veloworks.com for internal routing.

Two specific asks:
- Can Redwood push a daily invoice bundle to our portal (SFTP preferred) and also send a single daily summary email to ap@veloworks.com?
- We need a line-item VAT breakdown on each PDF and confirmation of how long Redwood retains invoice PDFs for audit purposes (our policy needs 7 years).

Can you confirm what you can support and what metadata you include (PO, billing entity, VAT IDs)? If helpful, we can share a sample of our portal schema.

Thanks — want to lock this before procurement (they need the delivery flow documented).

Best,
Elena Popov
Finance Ops | VeloWorks Inc.
ap@veloworks.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Popov <elena.popov@veloworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & archive retention — initial questions

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Happy to get this set up. Short answers up front:

- Yes, we can push daily invoice bundles to your portal. We support SFTP, S3, and API pushes.
- We can also send a daily summary email to ap@veloworks.com that includes links to the files and a CSV manifest.
- PDFs include a per-line VAT/tax breakdown by default; we can also provide machine-readable XML/JSON e-invoice formats if needed.
- Our standard retention is 3 years, but for enterprise/legal we can extend retention to 7 years (this requires a retention addendum in the onboarding checklist).

Two quick questions to finalize configuration:
1) Which delivery method do you prefer (SFTP / S3 / API)? If SFTP, please confirm SFTP host, path, and whether you want daily or hourly pushes.
2) Please confirm the AP email(s) to CC and the exact PO format you require (single PO per invoice or PO on manifest). Also share VAT ID + entity name to include on the invoice.

I've attached a sample invoice template so you can confirm fields. If that looks good we can provision the feed and schedule a short handoff with our billing ops.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_invoice_template.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Elena Popov <elena.popov@veloworks.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & archive retention — retention, VAT, and routing

Hi Elena — looping in billing ops (Marissa) so we can confirm retention and the exact delivery envelope. A few operational notes from our side: 

- Retention: we can extend to 7 years as an onboarding option; this will be documented in the billing onboarding checklist and our legal addendum.
- File formats: we can push PDFs + companion XML (UBL/Peppol-ish) or JSON manifest. Attached is our sample XML schema and our internal retention policy for reference.
- PO / VAT: we will include PO on the manifest and place the PO on the PDF header if you require. Please send your preferred PO format (e.g., PO: 12345-YY) and the billing entity VAT ID.
- AP email: we will send the daily summary to ap@veloworks.com and can cc up to two additional emails if you want AP + Treasury. Confirm any additional CCs.

Next steps: once you confirm SFTP host/path or provide API endpoint, Marissa will provision the push and coordinate a short security handoff (SFTP keys or API token exchange).

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: billing-retention-policy.pdf, sample_xml_schema.xsd

Thanks, Jonas / Laura — confirmation below so we can proceed with procurement: 

- Delivery: daily push to SFTP (preferred). SFTP details: sftp.veloworks.com:/incoming/redwood/ (we will share credentials via your DocuSign link).
- Email copy: daily summary email to ap@veloworks.com (please cc treasury@veloworks.com as well).
- PO / VAT: We'll include a single PO per invoice. Example PO: VW-PO-2025-9982. VAT ID: GB987654321 (billing entity VeloWorks UK Ltd).
- Retention: 7 years confirmed. We are okay with a retention addendum.

Attached is the completed onboarding form (signed) and the purchase order PDF. Here's the DocuSign link for the secure credential exchange: https://app.docusign.com/some/docusign-link-abc123

Please confirm when you have provisioned the SFTP and the first daily push schedule (we'd like first push on 2025-05-25).

Best regards,
Elena Popov
